HG002 example data · 2026-11-22

NIST Genome in a Bottle HG002 GRCh38 v5.0q structural variant benchmark.
On 2026-11-22 Apus selected the 2,477 bp deletion at chr1:108,190,703 and
the 975 bp insertion at chr1:152,304,195 from the RefSeq CDS-overlap subset
annotated with ONT BAM depth and sampled by allele at ≥5× depth.
Olson et al. https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.23.752440
https://ftp-trace.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/ReferenceSamples/giab/release/AshkenazimTrio/HG002_NA24385_son/v5.0q/
See ../NIST-DATA-NOTICE.txt for the benchmark data terms.

CSIR-Centre for Cellular and Molecular Biology, ONT Methylation Benchmarking
Datasets, accessed for this example on 2026-11-22. The BAM subset contains
90 alignments overlapping the deletion span or insertion anchor. The dataset
license is in ONT-MIT-LICENSE.txt.
https://registry.opendata.aws/ont_basemod_data/
https://ont-basemod-benchmark-data.s3.amazonaws.com/Analysis/modbam/mammals/human/HG002_public_5kHz_sup_v5.2r2_5mC.bam
Kulkarni et al. https://doi.org/10.1101/2024.11.09.622763 (preprint)
Kulkarni et al. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-026-75183-6 (published)

UCSC hg38 reference. The 1-based inclusive windows chr1:108,140,703–108,243,180
and chr1:152,254,195–152,354,195 retain the original sequence. Remaining
chr1 positions are masked with N and the FASTA contains only chr1.
https://hgdownload.soe.ucsc.edu/goldenPath/hg38/bigZips/
